unit.why: A pre-Hasidic legend about the birth of R. Abraham de Pisa, owed to his grandfather's hospitality toward Spanish exiles, followed by a moralizing note quoted from Midrash Talpiyot and Tanhuma.

stories.start_quote: הגאון כמוהר״ר אברהם דפיסה ולה״ה בא לעולם
stories.end_quote: כמו שרה שאירחה את האורחים עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: During the Spanish expulsion, R. Abraham de Pisa's grandfather lavishly supported and provisioned fleeing exiles; four sage elders, seeing his generosity, asked what he wished for, and when he asked for wise children they foretold a son within a year, to be named Abraham, whose grandson became the great scholar, a lesson in the reward of lovingkindness.

tags.why: Praises a pre-Hasidic Italian sage and his ancestor, taken from Midrash Talpiyot.

quotes: ראה כי ג"ח כמה הוא שמלבד השכר

tags.why: The narrative is wrapped in a homiletic frame on reward.
